pending_business_impacts.what: Product now supports RI&E work: action plan (plan van aanpak) with CSV export and 'you said, we did' page, response rate with <50% RI&E warning (Arbeidsinspectie werkinstructie werkdruk), works-council (OR) pack, QR join for shift workers, read-aloud, per-organisation minimum group size 10-50 (whole round needs max(20, 2k)). Persona research (26 Nov 2026, https://claude.ai/artifact/SxhH9jibNwparXg1YbHq6c) sets next items R35-R41: ro/uk/bg translations, focus-group fallback, own staff vs agency workers, aggression/unwanted-behaviour module, QEEW 2.0, manager module, independent anonymity audit.
pending_business_impacts.why_it_matters: Positions the product as the PSA/werkdruk building block of the RI&E rather than a stand-alone wellbeing scan; supports a fixed-price site package (scan + action plan + OR pack); shifts the channel towards certified RI&E experts, arbodiensten, sector (branch) funds and staffing agencies. Higher k raises the employee count needed per reportable group (cost/price per department, H13). Validated ro/uk/bg translations and an independent anonymity audit are new cost items; agency workers open a new market segment.
sections_to_check: channels and partners (scenario C, RI&E experts, branch funds, agencies)
